svg.title: frust
svg.desc: Measured source commit 321931ee0ebeaa02cd3177c18f12e5f002c56d17. Pixel-art FRUST wordmark and measured warm full/fat LTO clean rebuild: Cargo 4944 milliseconds; frust 144 milliseconds; 34.3 times faster. Median of 7 runs; observed Cargo range 4750–5010 ms, frust 136–153 ms. Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 255H | Linux 7.0.0-42-generic x86_64 | ext4 | rustc 1.97.1. Foreground build wall time; store policy deferred; cache compression auto. Build samples retain foreground millis, plus observed time from child exit until no job files remain and all existing slot locks are held exclusively together. Settled millis run from child start through that proof; helper counts and fallback frequency are not inferred. Maintenance rows and the separate churn section remain synchronous. Settled times are retained in source evidence, not substituted for foreground times. One codegen unit, panic abort; byte-identical executables. Animated fill duration ratio equals measured foreground ratio.
svg.text: shared cache / central targets / queued locks / clean UI
Intel Core Ultra 7 255H | ext4 | rustc 1.97.1 | median 7 runs
